lines.en: The trees give way when I stride.
Deep pits follow my feet.
Head low, I scent the ground.
My long tail drags a furrow.
I press slowly toward you.
I pause half a beat each step.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方蕨都断了
lines.en: Ferns snap wherever I pass.
I bowl whole bushes over.

lines.zh: 我在泥里留下三个爪尖。
lines.en: Three claw points remain in the mud.
I tilt my head to listen.
The creek only reaches my ankle.

lines.zh: 我慢慢收紧与你的距离。
lines.en: I slowly close the distance.
I stop and breathe hard.
Then I take one more step.
I stand, chest heaving.
I bite a broken branch.

lines.zh: 我从机器里出来，长得不太对。
lines.en: I came out of the machine looking wrong.
I open my jaw, a row of teeth.
I lift a claw and hold it midair.
I count the breaths in the wood.
Ash lies on my scales.
I test the ground's strength.
I tilt my head to your heartbeat.
An old scar runs on my hide.
I lift my tail and sweep it.
Steam rises from my snout.
I caught a scent.
My hunger has returned.
You're small, and you smell good.

lines.zh: 我鼻孔一张一合在闻你
lines.en: My nostrils flare, tasting you.
I'm looking at your neck.

lines.zh: 你的手抖得厉害，别攥拳。
lines.en: Your hands are shaking badly. Unclench them.
You won't get many steps.
This wood has no way out.
I've followed you the whole way.

lines.zh: 我的喘息，在树后也能听见？
lines.en: You can hear my panting behind the trees?

lines.zh: 一百二十点血，我饿了很久。
lines.en: A hundred and twenty points, and I have hungered long.
You'll do.
That iron is too thin.
Look up at me.
A plate of armor is gone from my shoulder.
I growl low and step back.
Blood runs down my leg.
You're stronger than I expected.
This skeleton isn't put together right.
I pause half a beat, then press on.
My hide is thick, the wound shallow.
My teeth grind; I hold it in.

lines.zh: 你比我预想的强，记住了。
lines.en: You are stronger than I expected — noted.

lines.zh: 这具身体不知疼，只知饿
lines.en: This body knows no pain, only hunger.
The blood smell is faint. Bring it raw.

lines.zh: 我这副骨架本来不该存在。
lines.en: This skeleton of mine shouldn't exist.
I smell blood.

lines.zh: 我是拧歪的暴龙，没有族群。
lines.en: A twisted rex with no pack.
Your hand is nearer.
Set it down, then don't move.
I won't touch that sort.
Keep it to save yourself.
Toss it over; I swallow bone and all.
You smell better.
You struck my shin bone.
Your iron on me is like iron on stone.
Don't stand where I plant my feet.
My tail shoved you aside.
That's not worth stopping for.
Three steps is not enough; one stride and I am there.

lines.zh: 骨头是机器拼的，撞不散
lines.en: Machine-set bones do not rattle apart.
You stepped in my print.
I drop my head to look at you.
Closer and it'll be too late.
There's no second one in this wood.
I came out of a machine.
I don't have such notions.
I have only hunger.
I do not even have kin.
Don't stand at my leg.
This is my ground.
There is only hunger in my blood.
I don't want to hear it.
Be quiet.
A piece of meat, I grip it.
Too small to fill me.
I crunch the bone.
This smells stale.
There are no companions.
I clear whatever's on the ground.
Two chews and the taste makes me shake my head.
I grind it into the mud.
This meat will not fill this frame.
I want more.
I've finally found you.
You're in this wood.
Ten steps is all I need.
My jaws are already open.
You've no other direction.
I sink my frame low.
When I start moving, the gravel rolls.
You heard that, didn't you?
So stop pretending.
I start to run.
Running well won't help you.
These two legs were pieced together.

lines.zh: 我是拼出来的，三十五点伤害。
lines.en: I was pieced together. Thirty-five damage.
It wouldn't help anyway.
When I run, the trees shake.
Trees fall at my flanks.

lines.zh: 我呼出的白气你听见没
lines.en: Do you hear the steam of my breath?
It's getting closer to you.
Your lungs must be burning.
My legs are longer than yours.
Whichever way you run, you're in the wood.
This wood can hold me.
Your steps have scattered.
Your hand is on a tree.
One shove of my shoulder and the tree snaps.
I knock it aside.
Your back is right there.
All my teeth are showing. Count them.
Half a tail's length to go.
This tree is the end. You are mine.
Precisely now.

lines.zh: 三十五点伤害都在牙上
lines.en: Thirty-five damage, all of it in my teeth.
Teeth meet bone.
One shove of my shoulder and you are in the ferns.
I bring a foreclaw down.
You roll to the roots.
My tail flattens the brush.
That cut landed on my scales.
I hit with my head. Hard enough?
You fall into standing water.
I lower my head to bite again.
Your shoulder is opened.
The taste of blood makes me hungrier.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，我多压一步
lines.en: For every step you yield, I press one more.
Your legs won't straighten.
That missed the vital spot.
Next time it won't.

lines.zh: 我从培养槽的蒸汽里站起。
lines.en: I rise out of the vat's steam.

lines.zh: 林中的鸟群全都飞走了。
lines.en: Every bird in the wood takes flight.
I land, mud spraying.
I open my jaws to test them.
My shadow covers a stand of ferns.
I don't belong to this wood.
But here I am.
I raise my head and scent the wind.
First step down and the ground sinks half a foot.
The ground gives half a foot.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有东西在动。
lines.en: I hear movement far off.
That will do.
I lift a foot and start.

lines.zh: 这片林里的活物都是我的。
lines.en: Everything living here is mine.
Stand still.

lines.zh: 我从槽里出来，这儿归我
lines.en: I came from the vat; this place is mine.

lines.zh: 火贴在我的鳞上，我甩头。
lines.en: Fire clings to my scales, I thrash my head.

lines.zh: 我从高处坠下，砸出一个大坑。
lines.en: I fall and blast out a crater.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的喉咙，我抬不起头。
lines.en: Water floods my throat, I can't lift my head.
The blast shoves me yards back.
That sank into my neck.
Magic burns beneath my scales.
Hunger weakens my legs.

lines.zh: 雷落在我背上，全身一颤。
lines.en: Lightning hits my back, my body jolts.
No ground to set foot on in the void.
